abstract: Seventy-two patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors (GTTs) and 20 first-trimester healthy pregnant women (controls) participated in this study. According to the WHO scoring system, GTTs were subgrouped into 24 hydatiform mole spontaneous regression (HMSR), 18 postmolar high-risk (PMHR) and 16 low- and 14 high-risk cases of choriocarcinoma. Patients with choriocarcinoma were treated with hysterectomy and methotrexate chemotherapy, whereas molar pregnancy was managed by either oxytocin infusion followed by suction evacuation or by hysterectomy. Serum p53 autoantibodies were determined by enzyme-linked immunosorbant assay and serum hCGbeta was determined by radioimmunoassay before and throughout the 12 months after treatment. p53 autoantibodies were not detected in normal pregnancy and cases of HMSR but were detected in all cases of PMHR and choriocarcinoma. Concentrations of p53 autoantibodies were higher in choriocarcinoma than in PMHR cases. Serial measurements of p53 autoantibodies dropped to an undetectable level within 1 and 6 months after treatment in cases of PMHR and low-risk choriocarcinoma, respectively. Decreasing values of p53 autoantibodies in high-risk choriocarcinoma remained higher than the cut-off level of controls. There was a significant positive correlation between p53 autoantibodies and serum hCGbeta concentration in GTTs. In conclusion, detection of p53 autoantibodies has a high potential for the differential diagnosis of GTTs and their serial measurements are clinically useful to monitor disease progression and to assess response to therapy in GTTs.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTT）の患者72例と、妊娠初期の健康な妊婦（対照）20例を本研究に組み入れた。WHOのスコアリング・システムに従い、GTTは奇胎自然退縮（HMSR）24例、奇胎後高リスク（PMHR）18例、低リスク絨毛癌16例、高リスク絨毛癌14例に分類した。絨毛癌患者は子宮摘除術とメトトレキサートによる化学療法で治療し、奇胎妊娠はオキシトシン点滴に続く吸引掻爬、または子宮摘除術で管理した。血清p53自己抗体は酵素免疫測定法で、血清hCGβはラジオイムノアッセイで、治療前および治療後12か月間にわたって測定した。p53自己抗体は、正常妊娠およびHMSRでは検出されず、PMHRおよび絨毛癌の全例で検出された。自己抗体の濃度は、PMHR症例よりも絨毛癌で高かった。PMHR症例および低リスク絨毛癌では、自己抗体の連続測定値がそれぞれ治療後1か月および6か月以内に検出限界以下まで低下した。高リスク絨毛癌では、低下後も対照群のカットオフ値を上回り続けた。GTTでは、p53自己抗体と血清hCGβ濃度の間に有意な正の相関が認められた。結論として、p53自己抗体の検出はGTTの鑑別診断に大きな可能性を持ち、その連続測定はGTTの疾患進行のモニタリングと治療反応の評価に臨床的に有用である。
